2609.25960.title: CausalLoss-Fin: Attributing Financial-Agent Loss to Decisions and Infrastructure Faults
2609.25960.paper_summary: When an agent handling a payment exception loses money, the agent-step attribution methods this paper compares against will name one of its actions. They will do so even when a settlement message was dropped and the agent never had a chance: they intervene on agent actions and do not expose infrastructure faults as intervenable variables, so every dollar they explain is charged to a decision. We take a benchmark whose fault process is explicit and replayable, decompose each episode's realised delivery schedule into named, individually repairable messages, and intervene on both the agent's choices and the infrastructure's. A telescoping identity splits any policy's loss exactly three ways: an infrastructure effect, a policy differential against the best implementable policy, and a reference-policy residual. Two of the three can be negative, so none is a share; Shapley then divides the first into signed allocations over individual messages. One result is structural and needs no corpus: an agent-only baseline identifies no infrastructure cause, because its model contains no variable that could name one. What 545 planted episodes across 3 policies measure is the size of that consequence. It misfiles 100% of infrastructure episodes and charges $114,383.40 to the agent. Repairing what it names recovers 0.0% of the available loss; repairing a minimal sufficient set recovers 100.0%. Scoring messages one at a time is not merely imprecise: 27.8% (95% CI: 23.3--32.3%) of episodes do not decompose additively. We evaluate deterministic programmatic policies rather than language-model agents, which is what makes replay exact and which limits external validity to stochastic agents. The prevalence figures are properties of this generator, not field rates.
2609.25960.paper_summary_zh: 當處理支付異常的代理人損失金錢時，本論文比較的代理步驟歸因方法將會指名其某一行動。即使在結算消息被丟棄且代理人從未有機會的情況下，它們仍會這樣做：它們干預代理行動，並且不將基礎設施故障視為可干預變量，因此它們解釋的每一美元都歸因於一個決策。我們採取一個故障過程明確且可重播的基準，將每個實現的交付時間表分解為命名的、可單獨修復的消息，並對代理的選擇和基礎設施進行干預。一個縮放身份將任何政策的損失精確地分為三個部分：基礎設施效應、相對於最佳可實施政策的政策差異，以及參考政策的殘差。三者中有兩個可以是負數，因此沒有一個是份額；Shapley 然後將第一部分劃分為對個別消息的簽名分配。一個結果是結構性的，並且不需要語料庫：僅代理的基準無法識別任何基礎設施原因，因為其模型中不包含可以命名的變量。545 個在 3 種政策下植入的實例測量的是這一後果的大小。它錯誤歸檔 100% 的基礎設施實例，並向代理人收取 $114,383.40。修復其所命名的內容回收 0.0% 的可用損失；修復一個最小充分集回收 100.0%。逐一評分消息不僅僅是不精確的：27.8%（95% CI：23.3--32.3%）的實例無法加法分解。我們評估確定性程序政策而非語言模型代理，這使得重播變得精確，並限制外部有效性於隨機代理。這些流行率數據是這個生成器的特性，而不是現場比率。
2609.25960.author: Abhishek Sharma et.al.
